intro: Designed to enhance corners and compliment every angle, our Frappe corner table brings modern sophistication and compact functionality to your living room.

features.title: Sleek and striking
features.text: Your table’s deep black finish brings a modern, refined edge that complements both bold and neutral interiors.

features.title: Strong at the core
features.text: Crafted with a durable rubber wood base, this corner table is built to stand strong while staying light and stylish.

features.title: Smooth to the touch
features.text: The top is made from MDF with Okoume veneer, giving it a polished feel and a premium look.

features.title: Perfectly petite
features.text: Its compact size is ideal for corners or smaller rooms—your style doesn't have to take up space.

features.title: Built for easy living
features.text: The knock-down construction means you can assemble it effortlessly wherever you want it to shine.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
